panels.title: background token refresh failure rate (ar ban?)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
$__timeGroup(a.datetime,$__interval) AS "time",
ifnull(a.rpc4,0)+ifnull(c.rpc4,0)+ifnull(d.rpc4,0) as 'rpc4',
ifnull(a.rpc5,0)+ifnull(c.rpc5,0)+ifnull(d.rpc5,0) as 'rpc5',
ifnull(a.rpc6,0)+ifnull(c.rpc6,0)+ifnull(d.rpc6,0) as 'rpc6',
ifnull(a.rpc7,0)+ifnull(c.rpc7,0)+ifnull(d.rpc7,0) as 'rpc7',
ifnull(a.rpc8,0)+ifnull(c.rpc8,0)+ifnull(d.rpc8,0) as 'rpc8',
ifnull(a.rpc9,0)+ifnull(c.rpc9,0)+ifnull(d.rpc9,0) as 'rpc9',
ifnull(a.rpc11,0)+ifnull(c.rpc11,0)+ifnull(d.rpc11,0) as 'rpc11',
ifnull(a.rpc12,0)+ifnull(c.rpc12,0)+ifnull(d.rpc12,0) as 'rpc12',
ifnull(a.rpc13,0)+ifnull(c.rpc13,0)+ifnull(d.rpc13,0) as 'rpc13',
ifnull(a.rpc14,0)+ifnull(c.rpc14,0)+ifnull(d.rpc14,0) as 'rpc14',
ifnull(a.rpc15,0)+ifnull(c.rpc15,0)+ifnull(d.rpc15,0) as 'rpc15',
ifnull(a.rpc16,0)+ifnull(c.rpc16,0)+ifnull(d.rpc16,0) as 'rpc16',
ifnull(a.rpc17,0)+ifnull(c.rpc17,0)+ifnull(d.rpc17,0) as 'rpc17',
ifnull(a.rpc18,0)+ifnull(c.rpc18,0)+ifnull(d.rpc18,0) as 'rpc18',
ifnull(a.wsError,0) as 'ws error',
ifnull(a.wsClose,0) as 'ws closed',
ifnull(a.wsMitmRecon,0) as 'mitm initiated reconnect',
ifnull(a.mitm500,0) as 'unknown error',
ifnull(a.mitm501,0) as 'retry later',
ifnull(a.mitm502,0) as 'worker stopped',
ifnull(a.mitm503,0) as 'reconnect',
ifnull(a.mitmLoginErr,0) as 'total login error',
ifnull(a.proxyBan,0) as 'proxy 3h ptc login ban',
ifnull(a.authReq,0) as 'Requesting auth',
ifnull(a.login,0) as 'Login successful',
ifnull(a.swTotal,0)+ifnull(c.swTotal,0)+ifnull(d.swTotal,0) as 'Accounts rotated',
ifnull(a.swWarnSusp,0)+ifnull(c.swWarnSusp,0)+ifnull(d.swWarnSusp,0) as 'Warned',
ifnull(a.swBanned,0)+ifnull(c.swBanned,0)+ifnull(d.swBanned,0) as 'Banned',
ifnull(a.swSbanned,0)+ifnull(c.swSbanned,0)+ifnull(d.swSbanned,0) as 'Shadow Banned',
ifnull(a.swDisabled,0)+ifnull(c.swDisabled,0)+ifnull(d.swDisabled,0) as 'Disabled',
ifnull(a.swDayLimit,0)+ifnull(c.swDayLimit,0)+ifnull(d.swDayLimit,0) as 'Daily limit',
ifnull(a.swRange,0)+ifnull(c.swRange,0)+ifnull(d.swRange,0) as 'Out of range 10 times',
ifnull(a.swTime,0)+ifnull(c.swTime,0)+ifnull(d.swTime,0) as 'Max connection time',
ifnull(a.swStop,0)+ifnull(c.swStop,0)+ifnull(d.swStop,0) as 'Stop cooldown',
ifnull(a.swLLapi,0)+ifnull(c.swLLapi,0)+ifnull(d.swLLapi,0) as 'LLapi',
ifnull(a.swQdist,0)+ifnull(c.swQdist,0)+ifnull(d.swQdist,0) as 'Quest distance',
ifnull(a.swConsecRPC,0)+ifnull(c.swConsecRPC,0)+ifnull(d.swConsecRPC,0) as 'consecRPC',
ifnull(a.backoff,0)+ifnull(c.backoff,0)+ifnull(d.backoff,0) as 'backoff',
ifnull(a.noAccount,0) as 'No accounts available',
ifnull(a.released24h,0) as 'released less then 24 hours ago',
ifnull(a.released7d,0) as 'released less then 7 days ago',
ifnull(a.minAuthT,0) as 'minimum auth time',
ifnull(a.maxAuthT,0) as 'maximum auth time',
ifnull(a.avgAuthT,0) as 'average auth time',
ifnull(a.monchange,0) as 'Pokemon changed',
ifnull(a.totRemoteAuth,0) as '#total remote auth',
ifnull(a.failRemoteAuth,0) as '#failed remote auth',
ifnull(a.faultyRemoteAuth,0) as '#faulty remote auth',
ifnull(a.minRemoteAuthT,0) as 'minimum remote auth time',
ifnull(a.maxRemoteAuthT,0) as 'maximum remote auth time',
ifnull(a.avgRemoteAuthT,0) as 'avgerage remote auth time',
ifnull(a.lowDuration,0)+ifnull(c.lowDuration,0)+ifnull(d.lowDuration,0) as 'lowDuration',
ifnull(bgRefreshSuc,0) as 'background refresh success',
ifnull(bgRefreshFail,0) as 'background refresh failure',
ifnull(bgRefreshFail,0)+ifnull(bgRefreshSuc,0) as 'background refresh attempts',
100*ifnull(bgRefreshFail,0)/(ifnull(bgRefreshFail,0)+ifnull(bgRefreshSuc,0)) as 'background failure rate',
ifnull(bTokenReq,0) as 'background token requests',
ifnull(bTokenSuc,0) as 'background token success',
ifnull(bTokenMin,0) as 'minimum background token request time',
ifnull(bTokenMax,0) as 'maximum background token requests time',
ifnull(bTokenAvg,0) as 'average background token requeststime',
100*bTokenSuc/bTokenReq as 'background token successrate',
ifnull(tokenCleared,0) as 'token cleared'

FROM dragoLog a
LEFT JOIN dragoLog_invasion c ON a.datetime=c.datetime and a.rpl=c.rpl
LEFT JOIN dragoLog_fort d ON a.datetime=d.datetime and a.rpl=d.rpl 
WHERE
a.RPL='$RPL'
GROUP BY 1  
ORDER BY $__timeGroup(a.datetime,$__interval)

SELECT
$__timeGroup(datetime,$__interval) AS "time",
rpc4,rpc5,rpc6,rpc7,rpc8,rpc9,rpc11,rpc12,rpc13,rpc14,rpc15,rpc16,rpc17,rpc18,
-- noGMO as 'GMO - giving up',
-- gmoPoke as 'Got a GMO: x pokemon',
-- 100*(gmoPoke-gmo0+gmo8)/gmoPoke as 'initial GMO success rate',
-- 100*gmo8/(gmoPoke+gmo8) as 'GMO failure rate 8/8',
-- (gmo0-gmo1)/gmo0 as 'GMO success after retry #1',
-- (gmo1-gmo2)/gmo0 as '#2',
-- (gmo2-gmo3)/gmo0 as '#3',
-- (gmo3-gmo4)/gmo0 as '#4',
-- (gmo4-gmo5)/gmo0 as '#5',
-- (gmo5-gmo6)/gmo0 as '#6',
-- (gmo6-gmo7)/gmo0 as '#7',
-- (gmo7-gmo8)/gmo0 as '#8',
-- gmo0+gmo1+gmo2+gmo3+gmo4+gmo5+gmo6+gmo7 as 'total retry',
ifnull(swTotal,0) as 'Accounts rotated',
ifnull(swWarnSusp,0) as 'Warned',
ifnull(swBanned,0) as 'Banned',
ifnull(swSbanned,0) as 'Shadow banned',
ifnull(swDisabled,0) as 'Disabled',
ifnull(swDayLimit,0) as 'Daily limit',
ifnull(swRange,0) as 'Out of range 10 times',
ifnull(swTime,0) as 'Max connection time',
ifnull(swStop,0) as 'Stop cooldown',
ifnull(swLLapi,0) as 'LLapi',
ifnull(swQdist,0) as 'Quest distance',
ifnull(swConsecRPC,0) as 'consecRPC',
backoff,
ifnull(lowDuration,0) as 'lowDuration'
FROM dragoLog

WHERE
RPL='$RPL'
GROUP BY 1  
ORDER BY $__timeGroup(datetime,$__interval)
